user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=Centre County tract-based zones constrained to the supplied county-subdivision coverage

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Constrain tract zones to Centre County coverage
workflow_steps.purpose: Use the supplied county-subdivision layer to constrain the tract polygon zones to the requested Centre County coverage.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the tract polygon layer by the supplied county-subdivision coverage. Preserve the tract-based analytical zones and write the result as GeoPackage.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by tract zone
workflow_steps.purpose: Assign hospital point records to the constrained Centre County tract zones and calculate total hospital beds for each zone.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially assign the hospital points to the Centre County tract zones and sum the hospital beds field for each zone. Runtime QC must ground the hospital numeric field from the observed schema and preserve the generated total-beds field in the output GeoPackage.

workflow_steps.title: Map total hospital beds
workflow_steps.purpose: Render the aggregated hospital-bed totals as a choropleth map.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the aggregated vector layer. Runtime QC must ground the generated total hospital beds field from the output schema; do not assume a mapped field name before inspection.

requirements.scope: The tract and county-subdivision polygon layers used by t1_clip_zones must have compatible CRSs for clipping.
The polygon inputs to t1_clip_zones must contain valid, non-empty geometries.
The polygon inputs to t1_clip_zones must be supplied in a format supported by the clipping worker.
The zone layer produced by t1_clip_zones must cover the requested Centre County area.
Hospital points and tract zones supplied to t2_sum_beds_by_zone must have compatible CRSs for point-in-polygon aggregation.
Hospital points and tract zones supplied to t2_sum_beds_by_zone must have valid, non-empty geometries.
The hospital input to t2_sum_beds_by_zone must contain the numeric attribute representing total hospital beds.
Inputs to t2_sum_beds_by_zone must be GeoPackage vector layers supported by the aggregation worker.
The aggregation zones used by t2_sum_beds_by_zone must represent the requested Centre County coverage.
The aggregated vector input to t3_thematic_map must be a GeoPackage or GeoJSON layer supported by thematic mapping.
The aggregated map input to t3_thematic_map must contain the generated attribute representing total hospital beds.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector geoprocessing including buffering, clipping, overlay/intersection, explicit geometry repair, and spatial joins. Binary spatial operations require compatible coordinate reference systems. Distance operations use the coordinate system and units of the provided input artifact.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
It does not automatically reproject inputs or repair geometries unless explicitly requested.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
